item.title: TLR-3X / TLR-3X USB – Multi-Fuel Weapon Light
item.description: There are few items as important on a defensive handgun as a good weapon light. It is critical to identify a target in low-light conditions. One of the biggest challenges, however, has always been power. The constant replacement of batteries gets old and costly. Streamlight, however, has just released a solid solution to meet our challenge, the Streamlight TLR-3X and TLR-3X USB – Multi-Fuel Weapon Lights. item.title: Lawful Exercise of Rights Should Not Cost a Life: Our Response to Alex Pretti’s Death
item.description: On January 24, 2026, Alex Pretti was shot and killed by Federal Agents during a protest in Minnesota. Videos of the killing have been widely circulated on news and social media. By all accounts, he was exercising his 2nd Amendment Right as a lawful gun owner to lawfully carry his handgun. By all accounts he was doing so while lawfully exercising his 1st Amendment Right to peaceably assemble. The lawful exercise of our enumerated rights, any of them, should not place one at risk of death. Bleecke

item.title: Colt Pythons — Modern Vs. Vintage
item.description: There are very few firearms that transcend their function and become cultural artifacts. The Colt Python is one of them. Even among people who do not shoot revolvers, the name carries weight. It implies craftsmanship, precision, and a kind of mechanical dignity that feels increasingly rare in a world of polymer frames and disposable consumer goods.
